lines.text: What's inside AI training data? Your words? A benchmark's exam questions?
Until now, every answer was a score. A percentage. Trust us.
Ingot answers differently. It shows you the words.
Drop a training corpus. The scan runs — and every overlap is shown word for word. Like this exam question, found inside twenty-one gigabytes of web text.
And what leaves your machine? Zero bytes. Not a policy — your browser enforces it.
Nine million documents scanned. Every published number gated in C I — and every report ends with a receipt anyone can re-run.
Ask it yourself — in your browser, or one command.
